text:
Maya: Super last-minute but whos up for a sunrise run + beach picnic tomorrow? thinking short jog, then coffee + toast on the sand. low-key.
Jordan: I can do sunrise if we keep it under 2 hours. Ill bring a French press and a small stove. :coffee: 
Priya: Im down for the picnic part, not the run. will meet you at 9:30am at the north parking lot.
Samir: Id rather surf but can do a quick jog beforehand. have room for two bikes + board in my trunk.
Maya: @Priya perfect  9:30 meet sounds great. @Samir if waves are small well picnic instead.
Jordan: Quick poll: run + picnic / picnic only / surf + picnic?
Maya: run + picnic > picnic only > surf + picnic (Im rusty on paddling).
Samir: surf + picnic > run + picnic > picnic only.
Priya: picnic only > run + picnic > surf + picnic.
Jordan: run + picnic > picnic only > surf + picnic.
DevBot: Reminder: thread-level poll closed: run + picnic wins (3 votes). Calendar: "Sunrise Beach picnic" Mon 2026-05-03 06:00 PST  attendees: Maya, Jordan, Priya, Samir  https://calendar.example/evt/67890
Maya: Alright looks like were doing the gentle run then picnic. checklist: blanket, thermos, sunscreen, wet wipes, trash bag.
Jordan: Ill pack the press + beans. also bringing a tiny folding table.
Samir: Ill bring a small speaker and a sponge for rinsing feet. happy to ferry gear.
Priya: Ill bring bagels (with vegan option) and cutlery. can anyone bring plates?
Maya: Ill grab disposable plates and an extra blanket. ETA 5:45 to the lot to warm up.
Jordan: Heads-up: tide is incoming around 7:30 so well set up near the dunes.
Samir: Noted. If anyones running late DM me, Ill text when were parked.
Priya: Thanks for organizing Maya! see you all tomorrow. :smile:
Maya: Yup! last-minute plans = best plans. :sun_with_face:
